name: game-forge
description: Make a game with Claude Code agents, measured instead of eyeballed: 3D models baked to 2D sprite sheets in Blender, free local image-to-3D and local asset models on Apple Silicon, batched art waves from an image model with crop and palette checks, bot-played deterministic playtests and screenshot proof, voice casting before paid generation, and the hard-won lessons from shipping a roguelite and a tower-defense game.
